role: CI gate: the code map is current (make codemap-guard; ci.yml and gates.yml step "Code map is current"; planted by verify_gates_fail.sh).
toplevel: set -euo pipefail; cd to the repo root. If the chosen interpreter cannot import tree_sitter and tree_sitter_swift, prints how to install them and exits 2, so a missing toolchain fails rather than reading as clean. Otherwise execs `codemap.py check`, whose exit code (0 clean, 1 problems) is the gate result.
